column30: Note: Online, I saw a number quoted even higher than here, around 7.8-7.9.  Also the reported MW is around 150 kDa: calculated is 102.  Heavily glycosylated, which will affect all of these numbers.

Recall, we used AI to generate a dummy sequence where the relative abundance is represented.  Unfortunately, this may not yield the same sequence or relative abundance (given as a range) each time.  This is what I generated this time.  If we don't like it, we can change it.  This is especially true around 7.4, where pI above will generate positive charge and below, negative.
